stage.name: Cityway 66
stage.description:
A cityway that once carried pioneers and hope as it stretched further and further west. Once. Now, the promises of the past have faded. The facilities once full of promise have fallen into disrepair, leaving only an invitation echoing over the airwaves: to clear out enemies.
<Special Conditions> DP will not regenerate naturally
<Waste Heat Vent> Deals Arts damage to both enemies and allies and reduces enemies' Movement Speed, but will charge their energy.

paramilitary_gangster_leader.name: Paramilitary Gangster Leader
paramilitary_gangster_leader.flavourText: A gangster hired to sow chaos, well-accustomed to brawls. Their employer has provided them with an experimental thermal amplification device.
abilities: Energy Capacity: 10; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a period of time.

paramilitary_gangster.name: Paramilitary Gangster
paramilitary_gangster.flavourText: A gangster hired to sow chaos, often picking fights. Their employer has provided them with an experimental thermal amplification device.
abilities: Energy Capacity: 10; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a period of time.

paramilitary_thief.name: Paramilitary Thief
paramilitary_thief.flavourText: A gangster hired to sow chaos, more interested in stealing property than injuring others. The thermal amplification devices they are equipped with have not actually been tested for safety.
abilities: Unblockable. Energy Capacity: 5; gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a period of time.

radioactive_originium_slug_enemy_1352_es.name: Radioactive Originium Slug α
radioactive_originium_slug_enemy_1352_es.flavourText: A wild Infected creature that accidentally consumed too much industrial waste, causing it to leak Arts energy upon death. More dangerous than ordinary radioactive Originium slugs, these low-intelligence creatures are easily manipulated by enemy casters to launch swarming attacks on manmade facilities.
abilities: When defeated, deals heavy Arts damage in an area and causes all enemies on the field to gain 1 Energy.

radioactive_originium_slug_enemy_1352_es.name: Radioactive Originium Slug
radioactive_originium_slug_enemy_1352_es.flavourText: A wild Infected creature that accidentally consumed too much industrial waste, causing it to leak Arts energy upon death. These low-intelligence creatures are easily manipulated by enemy casters to launch swarming attacks on manmade facilities.
abilities: When defeated, deals heavy Arts damage in an area and causes all enemies on the field to gain 1 Energy.

paramilitary_thief_leader.name: Paramilitary Thief Leader
paramilitary_thief_leader.flavourText: A gangster hired to sow chaos, adept at evading capture and acting quickly. The thermal amplification devices they are equipped with have not actually been tested for safety.
abilities: Unblockable. Energy Capacity: 5; gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a period of time.

paramilitary_axeman_leader.name: Paramilitary Axeman Leader
paramilitary_axeman_leader.flavourText: An outlaw hired to sow chaos, equipped with a thermal energy axe that consumes too much power. They will find a way to use their associates' energy supplies.
abilities: Energy Capacity: 20; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
Continuously drains 1 Energy from all nearby ground enemies.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a longer period of time.

paramilitary_defender_leader.name: Paramilitary Defender Leader
paramilitary_defender_leader.flavourText: A mercenary hired to sow chaos, equipped with a heavy protective suit that is charged in advance to preempt any energy leakage issues. In addition to causing damage, they are also responsible for compiling and submitting the team's test results.
abilities: Energy Capacity: 20; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
Starts with an additional 15 Energy, but loses 1 Energy per 10 seconds.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a longer period of time.

paramilitary_sniper_leader.name: Paramilitary Sniper Leader
paramilitary_sniper_leader.flavourText: An outlaw hired to sow chaos, well-accustomed to using thermal energy blasters and eager to just start blasting.
abilities: Energy Capacity: 20; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
Periodically stops moving and continuously provides Energy to all enemies within attack range.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a longer period of time.

paramilitary_bombardier_leader.name: Paramilitary Bombardier Leader
paramilitary_bombardier_leader.flavourText: A mercenary hired to sow chaos, equipped with a compressed-air grenade launcher. The gas cylinder has been heated to such a degree that their colleagues are afraid to get close.
abilities: Energy Capacity: 30; Gains [Overload] upon reaching max Energy.
Starts with an additional 25 Energy, but loses 1 Energy per 5 seconds.
While not blocked, launches grenades that deal damage to the target and surrounding units.
[Overload] Greatly increases ASPD, DEF, and RES for a longer period of time.

paramilitary_bombardier.name: Paramilitary Bombardier
paramilitary_bombardier.flavourText: A mercenary hired to sow chaos, equipped with a compressed-air grenade launcher. In complete disregard to safety regulations, the gas cylinder is pre-heated to increase weapon efficiency.
